description: The bar chart, titled "Efficient Reasoning via Chain of Unconscious Thought," compares the accuracy percentage of four different methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—on the left y-axis, which ranges from 70 to 100, while the right y-axis, labeled "Token Count," ranges from 0 to 800. The x-axis displays the four methods, each represented by a distinct colored bar: CoT (maroon), CoD (brown), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The accuracy for CoT is 91.19%, CoD is 80.89%, CCoT is 88.50%, and CoUT is 88.40%. The corresponding token counts are 676.85 for CoT, 534.24 for CoD, 445.91 for CCoT, and 354.46 for CoUT. The bars are sorted in descending order of accuracy, with CoT having the highest accuracy and CoD the lowest among the four. The token count for CoT is also the highest, while CoUT has the lowest token count.
